question: Does Serper refuse exact-phrase queries in double quotes on free accounts with an HTTP 400, and does it refuse any other query pattern?
why: A third-party report dated 2026-09-03 (note.com/bon_developer/n/n0181269c2a70) quotes the error 'Query pattern not allowed for free accounts' on a double-quoted query and says Serper support called exact-phrase queries blocked for free accounts, with no workaround on the free tier; no Serper page states it. Only an account that holds free credits can confirm it; if it holds, it is a limit on the free queries that the record does not carry.
